recommendation: Keep the audit as-is and do not reintroduce fulfillmentTime for current ServiceRequest. Any broader cleanup of unrelated clinical-reasoning example comments or legacy QUICK/CQL samples that still use fulfillmentTime should be handled under a separate focused issue because those examples are outside the ProcedureRequest conformance artifact decided here.
issue_request: FHIR-11179 was Published with resolution Persuasive with Modification. It asked to replace ProcedureRequest.scheduled with ProcedureRequest.fulfillmentTime because "scheduled" implied an appointment had already been made; the final resolution instead directed that ProcedureRequest and ReferralRequest align with the request pattern element name "occurrence".
initial_application: No direct commit mentioning FHIR-11179 was found. The issue was applied through the referenced GF#10293/request-pattern history and adjacent ProcedureRequest alignment work: e9a85998b0 introduced ProcedureRequest.occurrence[x] with a mapping from Sept2016 ProcedureRequest.scheduled[x], f4d7536caa changed ReferralRequest.fulfillmentTime to ReferralRequest.occurrence[x], and 06bd9f6ffe later renamed ProcedureRequest to ServiceRequest while preserving the scheduled-to-occurrence mapping.
additional_context: The current build no longer has an active ProcedureRequest resource. source/fhir.ini lists ServiceRequest as active, records ProcedureRequest as merged into ServiceRequest and ReferralRequest as becoming ServiceRequest, and keeps historical mappings from ServiceRequest.scheduled to ServiceRequest.occurrence and ReferralRequest.fulfillmentTime to ReferralRequest.occurrence. Current ServiceRequest defines occurrence[x] and maps it to Request.occurrence[x]. FHIR-11119 supports the ProcedureRequest/DiagnosticRequest alignment path; FHIR-11191 records that renaming occurrence to fulfillment/fulfillmentTime was not accepted for the request pattern.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the active conformance source already reflects the final decision: ServiceRequest uses occurrence[x], not scheduled or fulfillmentTime, and retired names remain only in historical rename mappings.
